lesson.title: Wonder as Practice
lesson.topic: How to cultivate and sustain curiosity and wonder in daily life through deliberate practice.
lesson.steelman: Can you develop a daily ritual that enhances your sense of awe and wonder, leading to deeper learning and engagement with the world?
lesson.example: A scientist who starts each day observing nature for 15 minutes to reignite their passion for discovery.

rationale: This lesson helps students develop a habit of wonder, crucial for maintaining intellectual curiosity throughout life.
